headline: Billions to the Budget and Record Revenues: How the 10% Duty on Soybeans and Rapeseed Changed the Market
summary: Soybean and rapeseed processing reached a historic record in Ukraine following the introduction of a 10% duty on the crops. Budget revenues also rose to record levels.
why: Ukraine is a major exporter of oilseeds, and changes to duties affect processing margins, state revenue and global vegetable oil supply.
